title: When Should LLMs Be Less Specific? Selective Abstraction for Reliable Long-Form Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.11908v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs are widely used, yet they remain prone to factual errors that erode trust and limit adoption in high-risk settings. One approach to mitigate this risk is to equip models with uncertainty estimation mechanisms that abstain when confidence is low. However, this binary "all-or-nothing" approach is excessively restrictive in long-form settings, often discarding valuable information. We introduce Selective Abstraction (SA), a framework that enables LLMs to trade specificity for reliability by selectively reducing the detail of uncertain content. We formalize SA through selective risk and coverage, and propose Atom-wise Selective Abstraction, a claim-level instantiation that decomposes responses into atomic claims and replaces uncertain atoms with higher-confidence, less specific abstractions. We develop a novel end-to-end pipeline for evaluating long-form generation that instantiates risk as factual correctness and measures cov

translated_title: LLM何时应该不那么具体？用于可靠长文本生成的选择性抽象
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛应用，但它们仍然容易产生事实性错误，这些错误削弱了用户信任并限制了模型在高风险场景中的应用。缓解这一风险的一种方法是为模型配备不确定性估计机制，在置信度较低时选择弃答。然而，这种二元的“全有或全无”方法在长文本生成场景中过于严苛，往往会丢弃有价值的信息。我们提出了选择性抽象，这是一个让LLM能够以牺牲具体性来换取可靠性的框架，通过选择性地降低不确定内容的细节程度来实现。我们通过选择性风险和覆盖率对SA进行了形式化定义，并提出了逐原子的选择性抽象，这是一种声明级别的实例化方法，将回复分解为原子声明，并用置信度更高、更不具体的抽象表述来替换不确定的原子。我们还开发了一种新颖的端到端评估流程，用于评估长文本生成，将风险实例化为事实正确性并测量覆盖率。
tldr: 该论文提出选择性抽象框架，让LLM在长文本生成中不再简单弃答，而是通过将不确定的具体内容替换为置信度更高的抽象表述，用具体性换取可靠性，从而在保留有用信息的同时减少事实错误。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Selective Abstraction, a framework that enables LLMs to trade specificity for reliability in long-form generation by selectively replacing uncertain atomic claims with higher-confidence, less specific abstractions, instead of abstaining entirely.
